contribution_rule.original_marketplace_verified_when: every realized sale included in the stored market-value sample has qualifying original marketplace evidence
contribution_rule.pending_when: one or more supporting realized sales remain secondary-source-only or discovery-only
contribution_rule.roi_effect: a pending contribution cannot satisfy the original-marketplace verification gate

qualifying_original_evidence: a direct original marketplace URL or stable original marketplace sale identifier is stored
the stored original evidence matches the sale identity, price and date used by the market record

fail_closed_rules: A contribution-level boolean cannot override sale-level evidence.
A secondary-source realized sale cannot be counted as original marketplace verified.
Queue summary counts must reconcile with sale-derived contribution state.
Verification priority ranks must be unique and contiguous.
Market source identity must match queue team, player, set and parallel.
